name: IEX_SCORE_HISTORIES
description: Stores historical data about collection scores.

columns.name: SCORE_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Primary key.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: STRATEGY_ASSIGNMENT_MATRIX_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a strategy assignment matrix.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Standard Who column.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: SCORE_VALUE
columns.description: Score value for this history entry.

columns.name: SCORE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the IEX_SCORES table.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the HZ_PARTIES table.

columns.name: ICO_ID
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: DEL_DELINQUENCY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to IEX_DELINQUENCIES_ALL table.

columns.name: SCORE_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the object to which the score applies.

columns.name: SCORE_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: The object code that describes the SCORE_OBJECT_ID column.

columns.name: SECURITY_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Standard Who column.

columns.name: PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Standard Who column.

columns.name: CURRENT_RECORD_FLAG
columns.description: Identifier of the latest score for the score object, if the feature is enabled. If the score object has the latest score, the value is Y. Otherwise, the value is NULL.
